title: Outcome
description: data of: outcome.py SESSION --json or outcome.py --night [DATE] --json. What each observation got, from what the run, the stack and the search wrote, against its programme's goals (docs/observing-plan-spec.md, Phase 1).

programme.description: The programme the field belongs to; null for a field none watches.

requested.description: Frames the run was asked for.

accepted.description: Frames the run's own check kept.

stacked.description: Frames in the final stack; null while the stack is pending.

depth_g.description: G where half of planted stars are found; null until depth.py has run.

out_of_line_share.description: Share of the field where the subtraction's spread was out of line with the noise model (difference.py): over the goals' quality_max, the subtraction, not the sky, limited the search, and the session is not worth it however deep.

search.description: Only running is pending: a failed or never-started search is said so, not left waiting.

owed.description: Candidates first seen here and on no other night: each owed a second look.

goals.description: The programme's or planned target's goals (goals.py): purpose, searchable_frames, worth_depth or worth_frames, quality_max, desired_frames, desired_depth, stretch_frames, stretch_depth.

gaps.description: Inferred: gaps between frames more than 30 s beyond the exposure and the camera's usual pace. The camera, or something else the run did between frames.

camera_retries.description: Recorded by the camera layer in each raw frame's header (TY_RETRY, TY_GOT_S): frames that needed a retry, the failed tries, and the minutes they took beyond the exposure. Null for sessions taken before 4 November 2026.

deferred.description: Frames the live stack had no time for, left to the quality pass: not rejections.
